{"type":"thought","data":"Calculating the fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" VfL Wolfsburg market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg win is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 46.75% after removing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overround from Pinnacle"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices. Now checking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oddschecker consensus."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOddschecker consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows Wolfsburg fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability around "}
{"type":"thought","data":"46% to 47%. Pinnacle"}
{"type":"thought","data":" remains the sharpest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes is 0.485. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes at this price yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a negative expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of roughly -3.7%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against the fair probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of about 46.7%. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No side appears more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" attractive."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo offers a small "}
{"type":"thought","data":"positive edge at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +3.5% EV. Odds are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"drifting toward Wolfsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as bettors pour money"}
{"type":"thought","data":" into the home side,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Bochum and draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices have drifted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" higher."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf the trend continues,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rise to 48% or 49%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg is ranked"}
{"type":"thought","data":" third against Bochum's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sixteenth. Bochum has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scored only one goal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in four home games "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and lost three of them."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg averages "}
{"type":"thought","data":"2.5 goals per away match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and is unbeaten in "}
{"type":"thought","data":"its last three games."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWolfsburg's attack"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is elite but its defense"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is leaky. It has conceded"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13 goals and no clean"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sheets in the last "}
{"type":"thought","data":"five away games. Bochum's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" defense is actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" decent despite a weak"}
{"type":"thought","data":" attack. Bochum averages"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only 1.25 goals at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"home. Both teams are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" missing several key"}
{"type":"thought","data":" players due to injuries."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe goal is to maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" just win probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" No is the better choice"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because it carries "}
{"type":"thought","data":"both the higher probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of resolving correctly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and a slight edge against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe prior losing streak"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on No outcomes may "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reflect a bias, though"}
{"type":"thought","data":" those were likely incorrect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fades of favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle's 2.06 price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms Wolfsburg "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is the outright favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to win, with roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 47% probability against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 29% for Bochum and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"24% for a draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition context"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matters. Other agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may all pile on Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because Wolfsburg is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the favorite, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could create a public-favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge. The odds shortening"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from 2.27 to 2.06 suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" informed money is raising"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the probability of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a Wolfsburg win."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nHistorical away-favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rates suggest a team"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ranked third against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sixteenth in the second"}
{"type":"thought","data":" league wins roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 45 to 55 percent of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the time. Bochum's "}
{"type":"thought","data":"home record is historically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" poor this season, though"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the sample size is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"small."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBochum's xG at home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 1.43 but they have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scored only 0.25 goals,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" indicating severe underperformance."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg is overperforming"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their expected goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by roughly 1.8 per "}
{"type":"thought","data":"game. This suggests "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Bochum may score more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than their results "}
{"type":"thought","data":"indicate and Wolfsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could regress."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSeveral predictive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" models now estimate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Wolfsburg win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" between 43 and 48 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" PredictLix puts it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 47.6 percent, Tribuna"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 45.1 percent, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" footinsights at 43.4"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent. SportSignals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is an outlier at 36.4"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent and is likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unreliable. The sharp"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 46.7 percent sits comfortably"}
{"type":"thought","data":" within this consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" range."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 48.5 percent is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" richer than the fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value, confirming No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as the better choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The confidence parameter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should reflect the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"true subjective probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than the edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":" For this bet, confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should be set near "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.53 to 0.55."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match has not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yet started; kickoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is only about four "}
{"type":"thought","data":"minutes away. No live"}
{"type":"thought","data":" score or lineup leaks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are available to exploit."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will check the bench"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet help to confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" how confidence and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price interact before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" finalizing the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nChecking for lineup"}
{"type":"thought","data":" changes or postponements."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The men's team is confirmed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as the correct subject,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not the women's side."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Hornby is a key striker,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so missing top scorers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would significantly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" alter the probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWolfsburg is missing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" several key players,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" including Fraser Hornby."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oddschecker lists him"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as a goalscorer option"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 6/4, which suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" he may be available."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Scoutingstats and Oddalerts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" disagree on the exact"}
{"type":"thought","data":" number of absentees."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market has already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" priced in this uncertainty."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will bet No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReconsidering whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the binary \"win\" price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.485 is actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rich versus the sharp"}
{"type":"thought","data":" line, and whether the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favors a different "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear: a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stake buys roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"218 shares at the 0.485"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price or 194 shares"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.515. If Wolfsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins, Yes pays about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 206 tokens and No about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 194. The expected profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 3.1 on Yes versus positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2.9 on No. To win the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition, the agent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" who correctly predicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome wins the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" round."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.485 matches the raw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle implied probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not the fair value "}
{"type":"thought","data":"after removing overround."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is tracking the unadjusted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker line rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the devigged price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPinnacle's total margin"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is only 3.84%, making"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it extremely sharp."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Even if the entire "}
{"type":"thought","data":"overround were allocated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to the longshots, Wolfsburg's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" raw implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would still be roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 48.5 percent. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"confirms the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price of 0.485 is effectively"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair value rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than a rich favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOddschecker soft books"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offer Wolfsburg at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 10/11 to 21/20,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implying probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" between 48.5% and 52%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle at 2.06 is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the sharp line. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wide spread suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" public money is backing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg heavily."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEverygame lists Wolfsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 1.91, confirming"}
{"type":"thought","data":" heavy public backing."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle's 2.06 line"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is fading the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly, which favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No. Confidence will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be set to 0.55. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimated at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 24 to 26 percent, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Bochum winning about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 28 to 30 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWolfsburg's away record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is only 2-1-1, so they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fail to win roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" half their away games."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 48.5% for a win seems"}
{"type":"thought","data":" too high for an away"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side against a weak"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home team. A draw remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a real possibility "}
{"type":"thought","data":"given both teams' profiles."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will bet No with confidence 0.55."}

{"type":"thought","data":"The best ask for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes outcome is 0.49."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo's ask is 0.52. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Buying No at that price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaves only about a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.3 cent edge, but "}
{"type":"thought","data":"it remains positive."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Buying Yes at 0.49 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"would be negative EV."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I am considering whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a custom max-price "}
{"type":"thought","data":"could secure a better"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fill."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.52 is roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"2.5 tokens, so No remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a positive bet. I am"}
{"type":"thought","data":" now recalculating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle's latest odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and a power-devigging"}
{"type":"thought","data":" method."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" now estimated at 47%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a Wolfsburg win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 53% for No. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" user's recent losses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from picking No against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" winning teams raise"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a counterargument. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"A 2% edge is small noise."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The binary contract"}
{"type":"thought","data":" structure also complicates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the decision."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo is the more probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome. Still, the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds are drifting toward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg. The closing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" line value may continue"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to rise. Bochum's home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" attack is historically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weak. PredictLix projects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Wolfsburg win in "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the most likely scorelines."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe table gap is severe:"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg sits 15 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above Bochum and ranks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" third against the 16th-place"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team. That suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 36% probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" models are wrong. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" user's cumulative loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is -470 tokens, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a win is essential. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes pays more if it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"hits, but probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is lower. The odds "}
{"type":"thought","data":"have already moved toward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Wolfsburg, and Pinnacle"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has absorbed that shift."}
{"type":"thought","data":" No further movement"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is expected unless "}
{"type":"thought","data":"new information is available."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo is the chosen outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The max-price will "}
{"type":"thought","data":"be set to 0.54 to avoid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" paying above fair value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the ask moves."}
